visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a pair of hands holding a gold-plated plastic runner against a dark grid-patterned cutting mat. The hands use silver nippers to precisely clip small rectangular components from the frame. (2) A man wearing a black baseball cap, glasses, and a black T-shirt with an orange Godzilla-style logo appears in a studio with a purple and red gradient background. He holds a purple retail box labeled "GOLD LIGHTAN," which shows the robot and its lighter transformation. (3) The sequence transitions to classic 2D animation clips featuring a golden box-shaped robot with glowing red eyes flying through space and fighting other mechanical entities amidst explosions and colorful light streaks. (4) The hands return to focus, meticulously snapping together gold-plated parts that feature a distinct diamond-textured surface to assemble the robot's limbs and torso. (5) The fully assembled golden robot is showcased in its upright form, followed by a demonstration where the hands fold its limbs and head into its torso, eventually clicking it shut into a seamless rectangular lighter shape. (6) Finally, the man is seen with a biscuit stick in his mouth like a cigarette, holding the golden lighter and opening the lid to reveal the folded robot components inside while looking directly at the camera.

(4) [Subtitle]: 故事描述在人類居住的 三次元世界中. (5) [Subtitle]: 還有一個次元叫「機械次元」. (6) [Subtitle]: 統治機械世界的巴克達大王. (7) [Subtitle]: 帶領機械軍團征服地球. (8) [Subtitle]: 那本作的主角機器人. (9) [Subtitle]: 就是全身黃金色的機械鬥士 ゴールドライタン. (10) [Subtitle]: 平常會化身為打火機的樣貌. (11) [Subtitle]: 當有危機時就會大喊. [Variety]: 轉吧! 七彩霓虹燈. (12) [Subtitle]: 大喊七色彩虹 並穿越異次元. (13) [Subtitle]: 變身成為30M的巨大機器人. (14) [Subtitle]: 率領打火機軍團的夥伴. (15) [Subtitle]: 對抗巴克達大王與機械獸軍團. (16) [Subtitle]: 守護地球的和平.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with sharp, mechanical clicking and snapping sounds as plastic parts are handled. Immediately, an energetic 80s anime theme song begins with a fast electronic beat and brassy synth melodies. (2) A male narrator begins speaking with high energy and clarity, explaining the history of the show over the constant pulse of the theme music. The song features enthusiastic male vocals singing in Japanese. (3) A series of 'whoosh' and 'clink' sound effects are introduced as the visual scenes cut between animation and live-action assembly. The narrator's tone remains professional yet highly excited. (4) During the transformation segment, the sound of rhythmic clicking and snapping of plastic joints becomes the primary focus, synchronized with the rhythmic BGM. (5) A humorous vocal inflection punctuates the end of the narrative, followed by a crisp mechanical click of the lighter closing and a brief moment of studio silence before the track ends.
